inputs_and_units: ingredient identity/mass; total mass kg; options may provide temperature K and ionic strength mol/L
outputs_and_units: pH; species/equilibrium outputs; activity coefficients dimensionless; buffer metrics
model_basis: equilibrium/speciation and charge balance with activity model; check code for supported species
valid_comparison_observable: measured pH for the same recipe, dilution, temperature, electrode/method and ionic-strength context
applicability_limits: IUPAC standard benchmark is component reference only; limited species and temperature-dependent pKa gaps

inputs_and_units: Exact canonical identity or CAS plus SINGLE_SUBSTANCE; as-supplied dose % w/w; explicit active-matter % and provenance; source-backed pure CMC and MW; pure CMC units M or mM
outputs_and_units: Ideal mixed CMC mM and mg/L; component active-mass and mole fractions; eligibility status/reasons; evidence references; explicit unavailable reasons
model_basis: Source-backed pure-component inputs followed by ideal Clint harmonic mixing on mole-fraction basis; historical broad-name mappings are HEURISTIC_SCREENING and excluded from app-facing prediction
evidence_level_or_maturity: MODEL_PREDICTION; source-backed input where applicable; never formula LAB_VALIDATED
valid_comparison_observable: Measured CMC for exact identities, composition, solvent, pH/speciation, ionic strength and temperature; formula validation requires matched lab observations
applicability_limits: Task 4 P2SURF verifies equation behavior only. Catalog audit: 0 fully supported, 8 partially supported SLS/SDS grades, 154 insufficient-input records. SLS active matter defaults lack lot-specific CoA; matrix, pH and non-ideality remain limitations

inputs_and_units: ingredient names and % w/w; optional product category and target pH
outputs_and_units: screening scalar cP (mPa s); approximate shear/temperature profiles and salt-curve categories
model_basis: ingredient-rule heuristics; fixed assumptions, Arrhenius-style temperature scaling, approximate power-law profile
valid_comparison_observable: matched formula viscosity at exact temperature, shear rate, geometry/spindle, protocol and sample history; full curve for curve output
applicability_limits: No fitted rheology model; ingredient grade, salt curve, shear history and full recipe metadata required; empty input is 1 cP reference_baseline only

inputs_and_units: ingredient names; explicit active matter where provided; dose; batch mass; hardness ppm CaCO3; wash volume

valid_comparison_observable: matched Ca2+/Mg2+ free-ion or residual-hardness observation at recipe, dose, pH, hardness, temperature and protocol
applicability_limits: Published constants are not raw validation observations; database mapping and conditionality limit generalization
